task: Two-signal T-cell activation gate (TCR signal-1 kinetic-proofreading discrimination + CD28 signal-2 required AND-gate); acute clonal-expansion kinetics (naive T cell -> ~10^3-10^4-10^5 progeny over ~1 week, division rate); the Wherry hierarchical-exhaustion program under chronic antigen (graded loss IL-2 > TNF > IFN-gamma, TOX-driven); checkpoint-blockade (anti-PD-1) reinvigoration as the decorrelated check (progenitor-vs-terminal subset, partial recovery).
confidence_tier: in-vivo-anchored (mouse LCMV tetramer-counting/adoptive-transfer/ATAC-seq/flow-cytometry kinetics for clonal-expansion and the exhaustion-hierarchy anchor -- a single, heavily-replicated animal model system) for Parts 2-3. The checkpoint-blockade decorrelated check (Part 4) is triangulated across mouse-LCMV + human-HIV + human-melanoma -- the strongest-anchored leg. The two-signal gate (Part 1) is citation-verified qualitatively; its numeric kp/koff/N parametrization is an illustrative first-principles mechanism demonstration, not calibrated to a measured TCR-pMHC off-rate constant -- same tier as this repo's MECHANISM_TAU_PATHOLOGY.md toy graph.

bretscher_cohn_1970.cite: Bretscher P, Cohn M (1970). A theory of self-nonself discrimination. Science 169(3950):1042-9.
bretscher_cohn_1970.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
bretscher_cohn_1970.numbers: Original two-signal/associative-recognition theory: induction requires obligatory recognition of TWO determinants (receptor antibody + carrier antibody); recognition of only ONE determinant induces paralysis (anergy). Framed in antibody/hapten-carrier terms (1970, pre-T-cell-receptor-era), generalized later to T cells by Jenkins/Schwartz and Harding et al.

jenkins_schwartz_1987.cite: Jenkins MK, Schwartz RH (1987). Antigen presentation by chemically modified splenocytes induces antigen-specific T cell unresponsiveness in vitro and in vivo. J Exp Med 165(2):302-19.
jenkins_schwartz_1987.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session (PMID corrected after recall-drift, see above)
jenkins_schwartz_1987.numbers: ECDI-fixed (chemically modified) splenocytes presenting antigen WITHOUT normal costimulation rendered T cell clones unresponsive for 'at least 8 d' to subsequent re-stimulation, both in vitro AND in vivo (B10.A mice) -- signal-1-alone induces active unresponsiveness, not mere non-activation.

harding_1992.cite: Harding FA, McArthur JG, Gross JA, Raulet DH, Allison JP (1992). CD28-mediated signalling co-stimulates murine T cells and prevents induction of anergy in T-cell clones. Nature 356(6370):607-9.
harding_1992.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
harding_1992.numbers: Direct experiment: anti-CD28 monoclonal antibody provides a costimulatory signal to naive CD4+ T cells and T-cell clones, and 'can block the induction of anergy' -- the CD28-signal-2 half of the AND-gate.

mckeithan_1995.cite: McKeithan TW (1995). Kinetic proofreading in T-cell receptor signal transduction. PNAS 92(11):5042-6.
mckeithan_1995.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
mckeithan_1995.numbers: Proposes TCR signaling as a kinetic-proofreading cascade (N sequential modification steps after ligand binding, each requiring continued engagement) that 'greatly enhances the receptor's ability to discriminate between a foreign antigen and self-antigens with only moderately lower affinity.' This doc's Part 1 implements the closed-form P_N=(kp/(kp+koff))^N directly from this mechanism.

zehn_2009.cite: Zehn D, Lee SY, Bevan MJ (2009). Complete but curtailed T-cell response to very low-affinity antigen. Nature 458(7235):211-4.
zehn_2009.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
zehn_2009.numbers: 'Very weak interactions are sufficient for activation, but strong TCR ligation is required to sustain T-cell expansion' -- challenges the view that strong TCR ligation is a prerequisite for activation itself; affinity instead gates EXPANSION DURATION (when contraction begins), not the initial activation binary.

muralikrishna_1998.cite: Murali-Krishna K, Altman JD, Suresh M, Sourdive DJ, Zajac AJ, Miller JD, Slansky J, Ahmed R (1998). Counting antigen-specific CD8 T cells: a reevaluation of bystander activation during viral infection. Immunity 8(2):177-87.

blattman_2002.cite: Blattman JN, Antia R, Sourdive DJ, Wang X, Kaech SM, Murali-Krishna K, Altman JD, Ahmed R (2002). Estimating the precursor frequency of naive antigen-specific CD8 T cells. J Exp Med 195(5):657-64.

'These 100-200 GP33-specific naive CD8 T cells divide >14 times in 1 wk to reach a total of approximately 10(7) cells.' ~5% of activated effectors survive to memory (~5x10^5 cells); >1000-fold precursor-frequency increase from naive to memory.

yoon_2010.cite: Yoon H, Kim TS, Braciale TJ (2010). The cell cycle time of CD8+ T cells responding in vivo is controlled by the type of antigenic stimulus. PLoS ONE 5(11):e15423.
yoon_2010.verified_via: NCBI eutils efetch, raw abstract text, fetched live this session
yoon_2010.numbers: Direct single-cell-level measurement (influenza/vaccinia infection, in vivo): 'CD8+ T cells could divide and proliferate with an initial cell division time of as short as 2 hours.' Explicitly NOT a fixed constant: 'controlled by the antigenic stimulus provided by the APC in vivo' (duration of G1 phase, tied to Rb phosphorylation state) -- division rate is itself signal-strength-dependent.

wherry_2003.cite: Wherry EJ, Blattman JN, Murali-Krishna K, van der Most R, Ahmed R (2003). Viral persistence alters CD8 T-cell immunodominance and tissue distribution and results in distinct stages of functional impairment. J Virol 77(8):4911-27.

wherry_2003.numbers: THE hierarchy anchor, quoted verbatim: 'Production of interleukin 2 and the ability to lyse target cells in vitro were the first functions compromised, followed by the ability to make tumor necrosis factor alpha, while gamma interferon production was most resistant to functional exhaustion.' Also: 'epitopes presented at higher levels in vivo resulted in physical deletion, while those presented at lower levels induced functional exhaustion' -- antigen LOAD/level is the driving variable. This exact order directly licenses this doc's Part 3 threshold ordering.

wherry_2011_review.numbers: Synthesis review: exhaustion defined by poor effector function, sustained inhibitory-receptor expression, and a transcriptional state distinct from effector/memory T cells; prevents optimal control of infection and tumors.

part2_relaxed_floor_divisions_ge_10.diagnosed_mechanism: draws 4 and 11: t_peak (expansion-window end) perturbed toward the SHORT end simultaneously with r_exp and/or t_lag moving unfavorably -- compounds multiplicatively since fold ~ exp(r_exp x window); a genuine joint-extreme sensitivity, not a bug, not loosened post-hoc

bugs_caught_and_fixed_disclosed: Part1 AND-gate: an absolute P_N>=0.5 activation cutoff broke the truth table (P_N at N=8 is ~0.004 even for the 'foreign' reference ligand, generically tiny for any ligand at that N) -- fixed to a log-space-midpoint threshold between the foreign/weak reference ligands.

Part1 Monte Carlo cross-check: N=8 true probabilities (~1e-4) give too few expected hits at 200k trials for a tight tolerance (a sampling-noise artifact) -- fixed by using N=3 (probabilities ~0.04-0.13) with 500k trials.

Part3 random-trajectory order check: comparing a None (threshold never reached in-window) against a real crossing time was counted as an order VIOLATION, conflating 'incomplete' with 'inverted' -- fixed to only count real inversions among thresholds actually reached; upgraded from a redundant monotonic-ramp sweep to a genuine fluctuating/non-monotonic stress test.

overall_verdict.note: All 21 individual falsifier sub-gates PASS at the literature's own nominal parameters. overall_pass=False in the raw results JSON reflects ONLY the disclosed, diagnosed Part-2 joint-parameter robustness result (10/12, not 12/12) -- not a failure of the falsifier itself. Reported exactly as measured, not loosened or hidden.

symmetric_qc_open_items: Exhaustion is a continuous spectrum, not 4 discrete boxes -- the ordered-threshold model (Part 3) demonstrates a simple 1-D geometry is SUFFICIENT to reproduce the reported staged pattern, not that exhaustion literally proceeds in discrete jumps.

Progenitor-vs-terminal (Part 4) is itself a 2-state simplification of a richer, >=4-subset continuum (Beltra et al 2020, named in this repo's own IMM-TCELL-EXHAUSTION graph node) -- not independently verified or extended here.

Mouse-LCMV vs human-tumor (and human chronic infection) genuinely differ in kinetics, antigen persistence, and tissue context -- Parts 2-3's precise numeric rate/threshold parameters are mouse-LCMV-specific; only Part 4's QUALITATIVE pattern (partial, progenitor-dominated recovery) is shown to generalize to humans (Huang 2017, Trautmann 2006), not the mouse rate constants themselves.

The '3/day' and '0.5/day' rates (De Boer 2001) are POPULATION-MODEL-INFERRED (a nonlinear parameter-estimation fit), not a direct single-cell stopwatch measurement -- only Yoon 2010's 'as short as 2h' figure is closer to a direct single-cell-level measurement, and even that is itself antigen-stimulus-dependent, not fixed.

The task's own literal '6-8h' division-rate figure does not trace to one single verbatim quote found this session -- the model's own implied 5.545h figure is bracketed by, and consistent with, but not identical to, both Yoon 2010's 2h (fastest-observed) and the commonly-cited 6-8h band; reported precisely, not rounded to force a match.

The robustness sweep is 83% (10/12), not 100%, for Part 2 under +/-30% JOINT parameter perturbation -- a genuine, diagnosed sensitivity to simultaneous extremes in t_peak/r_exp/t_lag, disclosed as such.

Part 1's kp/koff/N parametrization is illustrative, not calibrated to a measured TCR-pMHC dissociation-rate constant -- the qualitative structural claims (discrimination sharpens with chain length; CD28 is a required AND-gate) are the load-bearing result.
Part 3's threshold SPACING (15/30/50/80 S-units) is illustrative -- only the ORDER is directly licensed by Wherry 2003's own verbatim wording.
S_fix=12 (Part 4) is a disclosed cross-paper reuse of Philip 2017's 'day 12' fixation point, not an independent re-derivation.
